newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in profit taking.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down 0.39 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 505.23 from 507.19 on Friday.
Total volume was 817,365 dinars against 12.975 million dinars over the previous session.
"Speculators are taking their profits since last Wednesday after shares edged higher on good annual results for several of them," a broker said.
ATB bank dropped 2.12 dinars to 33.88 dinars. Banque de Tunisie fell 1.14 dinars to 79 dinars.
Chemical firm SPCD slid 1.14 dinars to 37.26 dinars. Coke and beer bottler SFBT was down one dinar to 94.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was up one dinar to 35 dinars.
BDET bank advanced 1.16 dinars to 16.94. UBCI bank was up 1.3 dinars to 52.1. UIB bank rose 0.11 dinar to 13.21 dinars. ($1= 1.08 dinar)
